additional_info.subject: RE: ID0396194-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N8 160373414] Outlets Unavailable CRM:00797001582
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-DE Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
HHVA
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N8 160373414
Charger ID/Serial No.:
RTMPJx
Problem Description: Outlets Unavailable
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
1st August 2024
, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
The customer opened a ticket stating that the two DC charging points are not available. Upon reviewing the logs, we noticed that the charger went SCB offline on 2024-12-12 at 00:13:22 (UTC time). We checked the logs from the last 10 hours when it went offline on SCB, and during that time, the charger was healthy and online on the OCPP backend as well. We also noticed that there were successful charging sessions on both DC outlets.
Unfortunately, without an SCB connection, our ability to provide remote assistance is limited. We recommend the following steps:
Perform a Hard Reset:
If the charger is connected to the OCPP server, initiate a hard reset from the OCPP.
Conduct a Local Reboot:
If the charger is powered and the router is connected to the internet, a local reboot may help bring the charger back online.
If these steps do not restore the SCB connection, we recommend doing an onsite investigate further. Several factors could be responsible for the charger being offline on the SCB, including:
Internet Connectivity Issues:
Siemens router failover function switching the WAN from cellular to Ethernet.
Mobile network issues, such as:
Disabled or expired SIM card.
Exhausted monthly data volume.
Weak signal strength due to changes in radio transmission conditions.
M2M contracts where the IP may not be enabled.
Router-Related Issues:
Teltonika router switching to an incorrect network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Hardware failure or software crash of the router.
We recommend carrying a spare router if onsite troubleshooting is planned, to address any potential router issues.
Once the charger is back online on SCB, check why the outlets are unavailable and take the necessary action.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sominath Nagalgaon
